rows.Benefits Description.Note: The calendar: If you receive care for your accidental injury within 48 hours, we cover outpatient medical services and supplies billed by a/an: • Treatment in an outpatient facility or in the outpatient/ emergency room department of a hospital • Related outpatient physician care • Related diagnostic services Note: Emergency room charges associated directly with an inpatient admission are considered 'Other charges' under Inpatient hospital benefits in Section 5(c) and are not part of this benefit, even though an accidental injury may be involved. Expenses incurred after 48 hours, even if related to the accident or injury, are subject to regular benefits. See applicable Section for cost share. This provision also applies to dental care required as a result of accidental injury to sound natural teeth. See Section 5(g),
